prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 86.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 94.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 78.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Summoning Sandbox: Introduces an interactive desktop summoning sandbox on the finish step where users practice calling, clicking, and dismissing their pet directly on screen. (why: 3 support emails noted post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step median time is high (395s).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Safeguard Modal: Shows a clear prompt explaining how sign-in protects pet data across device re-installs and logins. (why: 8 support emails (highest volume) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again on different sessions.)
2: [adoption, layout] Instant Companion Audio & Visual Preview Grid: Overhauls the pick_friend layout into a split interactive showcase featuring instant pet audio clips and animation previews. (why: Adoption step drops 22% of users and has a long mean completion time (1017s).)
3: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Interactive Companion Teaser: Updates the story screen copy and button labels to clearly outline what desktop pets do before choosing a path. (why: Long average time on path selection (514s) shows users need immediate context on what desktop pets do.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Quick Reference Overlay: Displays a persistent shortcut cheat sheet on home_intro showing system tray icon locations and quick hotkeys. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide/talk to pet.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Creation Expectation Callout: Adds clear render time estimates and photo guidelines on the upload_photos screen before creation begins. (why: Custom pet generation issues reported in 3 emails, plus adoption step speed friction.)
